target_and_action_as_stated: Described as a T-type calcium channel blocker (Methods wording, by citation); catalogue lists T-type block only; the source paper's oocyte data show a GIRK block near the labelled band.
general_anticonvulsant_activity: The Wwox paper cites it as having anticonvulsant activity in PTZ mice; the cited reference tests anticonvulsant effect, not channel block.
wwox_specific_rationale: T-type node proposed: suppressed the late PTZ seizure score significantly only in the null genotype; one experiment, no interaction test, floor-limited wild type; no T-type measurement in Wwox tissue.
kept_separate_note: Provoked seizure score in null pups only; not development, function or quality of life; do not transfer to Z944.

target_and_action_as_stated: Non-selective GSK3 inhibitor, Mg2+-competitive; also inositol monophosphatase inhibition (IT15); a documented pro-convulsant sign of the second action in rodents (by analogy).
general_anticonvulsant_activity: Lowered the PTZ seizure score in null, heterozygote and wild-type pups alike; the authors report it as better than ethosuximide.
wwox_specific_rationale: GSK3beta de-repression proposed (Ser9 phosphorylation falls in the null); not WWOX-specific because the effect is present in wild type.
kept_separate_note: Provoked seizure score only; the opposing push on the Wnt need is a separate issue; a lithium effect is not by itself GSK3 dependence.

general_anticonvulsant_activity: Reduced onset and severity of audiogenic seizures dose-dependently in mice homozygous for a GluN2A gain-of-function change (abstract), more in females.
wwox_specific_rationale: NONE_STATED (no WWOX model with an NMDAR modulator was identified; the d-APV burst result is a dependence, not a rationale for this drug).
kept_separate_note: Reflex seizures, acute; not chronic control and not development; efficacy shows the lever, not the lesion.

target_and_action_as_stated: Uncompetitive open-channel NMDAR pore blocker, fast off-rate.
general_anticonvulsant_activity: ATP1A2-related infant case: status epilepticus partly responsive to ketamine, seizure-free once memantine was added (one case, concomitant ketamine and timing not separable). GRIN-variant retrospective series: benefit 14 of 19 gain-of-function versus 3 of 15 loss-of-function or indeterminate; seizure-frequency reduction 7 of 18 versus 2 of 10, not different; three gain-of-function individuals worsened. Memantine accelerated provoked seizures in an adult rat model; no paediatric effectiveness on its label.
wwox_specific_rationale: Hypothesis only (HYP-20261027-01, generated, exploratory): graded partial block of the d-APV-sensitive node; no WWOX model with memantine found; the sign depends on the lesion, unknown for WWOX.
kept_separate_note: Human reports are non-WWOX; one case does not support chronic efficacy; benefit rating in the series is not seizure frequency.

target_and_action_as_stated: Physiological way to lower NMDAR gain by extracellular Mg2+ (rationale of the need); not a bath concentration.
general_anticonvulsant_activity: In the one randomised open-label infant trial read (West syndrome, 48 analysed, ACTH and antiseizure drugs in both arms) magnesium did not change seizure control (p 0.69); a positive randomised signal exists with ACTH at abstract level.
wwox_specific_rationale: Only the NMDAR-gain rationale; no Mg2+ manipulation in a WWOX system.
kept_separate_note: Open-label infant trials are not evidence about this node; a supplement is not a bath concentration.
